correctness.rationale: Independent verification confirms every essential inference. K_t=S x B'_t with S=[-1,1]^2 (area 4) and B'_t={(x,y):|x|<=1,t|x|+|y|<=1} (area 4-2t by Fubini integral of 2-2t|x| over [-1,1]; rechecked by exact shoelace at 5 rationals). Polar fiber (B'_t)^o={(u,v):|v|<=1,|u|+(1-t)|v|<=1} has area 2+2t (shoelace on vertices (1,0),(t,1),(-t,1),(-1,0),(-t,-1),(t,-1) gives 2+2t including degenerate endpoints; matches polar-vertex normals of the 6 facet inequalities). Product-polar identity |K_t^o|=|S^o||(B'_t)^o|/C(4,2)=2(2+2t)/6=(2+2t)/3 verified against endpoints: t=0 gives 2/3=2^4/4! (B_1^4) and t=1 gives 4/3 (polar of B_inf^2 x B_1^2). Exact product P(t)=(16-8t)(2+2t)/3=(16/3)(2-t)(1+t)=32/3+(16/3)t(1-t) holds identically. Gap inequality P-32/3-(1/100)t^2(1-t)^2=t(1-t)[16/3-t(1-t)/100]>=0 since t(1-t)<=1/4<1600/3. Shadow data valid: 16 trajectories (a,b,c,d)->(a,b,c,(1-t)d) velocity (0,0,0,-d) plus 8 static (a,b,0,+-1) velocity 0, all parallel to e4 with v(-x)=-v(x); conv equals S x B'_t; vertex census 16->24->16 correct (fiber 4->6->4; static points are edge-midpoints at t=0 and corner pairs merge at t=1). Replay script inputs/artifacts/fallback_certificate.py re-executed: PASS with worst margin 6400/3 (~2133x). Proof is rigorous analytic with exact rational arithmetic; no numerical quadrature or unbounded error. Limitations honestly separated (no BM modulus, no sharpness, no 4D minimality).
